svg.title: Strategic alignment and validation matrix
svg.desc: The strategy requires a self-contained Windows multi-WAN product with a first-party driver, secure transport, production GUI, offline installer and release evidence. Several foundations are implemented in source and Rust CI, but driver runtime, production named-pipe IPC, WinUI GUI, measured network acceptance and release sign-off remain outstanding.
svg.text: Blueprint rev 2.1 objectives translated into current artifacts, missing evidence, and decision implications

g.text: C1 · Multi-WAN
Bonding, load balance, failover
Rust scheduling, tunnel, reordering, reinjection, failover
Unit + simulated E2E + real UDP socket tests
SOFTWARE-PROVEN
No WDK miniport path, netem or Rig B measurement
G2/G4 remain open; cannot claim real link aggregation
C2 · Self-contained
No third-party runtime engine
Pinned crypto dependency policy; locked graph; CI audit
Latest audit passed on merged main
POLICY CI GREEN
Continue audit on dependency changes; no release bundle audit
Code policy evidence is not runtime packaging validation
C3 · Offline install
Provision + rollback
Journal, rollback logic, SBOM sidecar handling and CLI tests
Exclusive private default journal; transaction tests
SOURCE / UNIT TESTS
No production MSI/bootstrapper, clean VM, offline run or rollback drill
G4 and G5 blocked; runtime bundle absent
C4 · Supply chain
Minimal deps + inventory
SPDX 2.3 + 3.0.1 generators; schema/SHACL gates; artifacts
Latest Ubuntu CI build includes both validators
INVENTORY CI GREEN
No reviewed VEX, signing attestation or clean-machine sidecar validation
G7 incomplete; inventory is not a vulnerability assessment
Windows-native product
Driver, service, GUI
NDIS/WDF C source + loopback lab service + Rust lab CLI
Windows Rust CI passes; no WDK build is part of CI
NOT PRODUCTIZED
Named-pipe caller auth and WinUI 3/.NET desktop app missing
Production architecture endpoints not yet delivered
C5 · Gate governance
Evidence-based release
Blueprint, ADRs 0002–0038, CI history and test procedures
Planning coverage is documented
DOCUMENTED
No dated G1 sign-off, staffed baseline or sprint/velocity ledger
Schedule and overall completion % cannot be substantiated

svg.text: Strategic verdict: strong first-party software and CI foundations; product maturity is gated by kernel/Windows integration and empirical acceptance, not additional feature-count estimates.
